```{r}
#| label: fig-itpc
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of ITPC values and their differences between PRESTIM and STIM soud stimulation condition"
#| column: page         # span full page width (HTML)
#| fig-width: 16        # inches on the graphics device
#| fig-height: 8        # adjust to keep aspect you like
#| fig-dpi: 200         # crisper lines when wider
#| fig-align: center
# packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)  # for nice breaks
library(stringr)

# --- load & tidy ---
itpc <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/Destrieux_final_itpc.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(type %in% c("prestim_itpc", "stim_itpc")) %>%
  mutate(
    S = case_when(
      type == "prestim_itpc" ~ "prestim",
      type == "stim_itpc"    ~ "stim",
      TRUE ~ type
    ),
    itpc = value
  ) %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, itpc) %>%
  distinct()

# (optional but safe) average duplicate rows first
itpc_avg <- itpc %>%
  group_by(subject, roi, S) %>%
  summarise(itpc = mean(itpc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# wide format + within-subject difference
itpc_wide <- itpc_avg %>%
  mutate(S = factor(S, levels = c("prestim", "stim"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = S, values_from = itpc) %>%
  drop_na(prestim, stim) %>%
  mutate(diff_itpc = stim - prestim)


# --- shared x from data ---
vals_cond <- itpc_avg$itpc
vals_diff <- itpc_wide$diff_itpc

rng          <- range(c(vals_cond, vals_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
pad          <- diff(rng) * 0.04
xlim_shared  <- c(rng[1] - pad, rng[2] + pad)
breaks_shared <- breaks_extended(n = 7)(c(vals_cond, vals_diff))

# ITPC by condition
p_cond <- ggplot(itpc_avg, aes(x = itpc, y = S, fill = S)) +
  stat_halfeye(point_interval = median_qi,
               .width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95),
               adjust = 0.7, slab_alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim_shared,
                     breaks = breaks_shared,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

# Paired differences (stim − prestim)
p_diff <- ggplot(itpc_wide, aes(x = diff_itpc, y = "stim − prestim")) +
  stat_halfeye(point_interval = median_qi,
               .width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95),
               adjust = 0.7, slab_alpha = 0.6, fill = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim_shared,
                     breaks = breaks_shared,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Shared x-axis (from data)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())

p_combined <- p_cond / p_diff + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
p_combined
```

```{r}
source(here::here("R/utils.R"))

e <- new.env()
load(here::here("notebooks/itpc_diff_rba.RData"), envir = e) 

ls(e)          # see what's inside
spectral_offset_sigma <- e$fm     # pull just the object(s) you want
# model <- e$model
 #1. Extract S effects for each ROI
# Note: In your model, S is a factor with levels "prestim" and "stim"
# The parameter name will be "Sstim" (contrast against baseline)


# Extract ONLY the Intercept effects (the only population-level effect in your model)
intercept_effects <- extract_region_effects(
  fit = spectral_offset_sigma,
  region_var = "ROI",  # Use "ROI" (capital) - RBA default
  parameter = "Intercept",
  digits = 4
)

# Create results dataframe
results_df <- data.frame(
  roi = rownames(intercept_effects),
  mean_effect = intercept_effects$mean,
  sd = intercept_effects$SD,
  p_plus = intercept_effects$`P+`,
  lower95 = intercept_effects$`2.5%`,
  upper95 = intercept_effects$`97.5%`
) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = (lower95 > 0) | (upper95 < 0),
    effect_direction = case_when(
      mean_effect > 0 ~ "increase",
      mean_effect < 0 ~ "decrease",
      TRUE ~ "no_change"
    )
  )

head(results_df) %>%  
  mutate(roi = case_when(
    roi == "lh_Medial_wall" ~ "lh_medial_wall",
    roi == "rh_Medial_wall" ~ "rh_medial_wall",
    TRUE ~ roi
  ))
# "lh_Medial_wall" "rh_Medial_wall"
```

# Plot ITPC on brain 
```{r}

## assumes:
##   results_df$roi   -> ROI names from your results
##   df <- desterieux$data
##   df$label         -> region names from the atlas/data



df <- desterieux$data
# 1) Pull the unique values (drop NAs)
roi      <- results_df$roi %>% na.omit() %>% unique()
regions  <- df$label           %>% na.omit() %>% unique()

cat("Counts (unique, non-NA):\n")
cat("  results_df$roi :", length(roi), "\n")
cat("  df$label       :", length(regions), "\n\n")

# 2) STRICT equality (exact strings, order ignored)
strict_equal <- setequal(roi, regions)
cat("Strict set equality (exact match):", strict_equal, "\n")

if (!strict_equal) {
  only_in_roi     <- setdiff(roi, regions)
  only_in_regions <- setdiff(regions, roi)

  cat("\nIn results_df$roi but NOT in df$label:\n")
  print(sort(only_in_roi))

  cat("\nIn df$label but NOT in results_df$roi:\n")
  print(sort(only_in_regions))
}

# 3) Row-wise coverage: are all result rows mappable to a region?
all_rows_have_match <- all(results_df$roi %in% df$label)
cat("\nAll rows in results_df$roi exist in df$label (strict):", all_rows_have_match, "\n")

if (!all_rows_have_match) {
  cat("\nProblem ROIs with counts (strict):\n")
  print(sort(table(results_df$roi[!(results_df$roi %in% df$label)]), decreasing = TRUE))
}

# 4) NORMALIZED comparison (trim + lowercase + collapse internal whitespace)
normalize <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_squish() %>%     # collapse internal whitespace
    str_trim() %>%       # trim edges
    str_to_lower()       # lowercase
}

roi_norm     <- normalize(roi)
regions_norm <- normalize(regions)

norm_equal <- setequal(roi_norm, regions_norm)
cat("\nNormalized set equality (case/space-insensitive):", norm_equal, "\n")

if (!norm_equal) {
  cat("\n(Normalized) In ROI but not in regions:\n")
  print(sort(setdiff(roi_norm, regions_norm)))
  cat("\n(Normalized) In regions but not in ROI:\n")
  print(sort(setdiff(regions_norm, roi_norm)))
}

```



```{r}

# Filter for  ROIs having a strong evidence of offect
significant_rois <- results_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_plus > 0.975 | p_plus < 0.025) %>%  # Changed from s_effect_pplus
  arrange(desc(abs(mean_effect)))  # Changed from s_effect

print("Number of ROIs with significant effect:")
print(nrow(significant_rois))

print("\nTop 10 ROIs by absolute effect size:")
print(head(significant_rois, 10))

# Don't strip the hemisphere prefix - keep the original ROI names!
viz_df <- results_df %>%
  rename(label = roi) %>%  # atlas expects 'label', not 'region'
  select(label, mean_effect, p_plus, sd, lower95, upper95, significant)

# Now the plot should work
p_mean_all <- my_brain_plot(
  df = viz_df,
  atlas_df = desterieux,
  parameter = mean_effect,
  filltype = "RdBu",
  legend = TRUE,
  limits = c(-0.32, 0.32)
) +
  ggtitle("ITPC Difference Effect (stim - prestim)\n(All ROIs)")

p_mean_all
```
